entities.name: Józef Innocenty Guz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Innocent Guz, born Joseph Adalbert Guz, was a Polish Conventual Franciscan friar who was martyred by a Nazi guard at the Oranienburg-Sachsenhausen concentration camp (Germany), June 6, 1940. He was beatified in 1999 by Pope John Paul II.
